description: Reads one entity (a thing of the game that makes noise) with everything about its sounds: its image, its events and every generated variation of each event (prompt, duration, chosen or not, audio link). Also returns the site pages to give the user: the entity (url: opens it, with its sound cards), each event (url: the player to listen, choose, trim and combine) and each variation's editor (editUrl). Read-only, costs nothing. Use it before choose_sound, save_sound or generating again, to see what already exists. To find an entity's id, use get_game; for the events of a folder, list_folders.

entity_id.description: The entity id, from get_game or create_entity.

include_image.description: Sends the entity image along (default true). false saves tokens when you only need the sounds.

name: get_entity
title: Entity details
